headline: Claude Haiku 5.5 Reshapes AI Pricing Landscape
summary: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5, with its superior performance and 90% price reduction, is driving intense competition in the AI market, challenging established players and altering the economic dynamics of AI inference.
whyItMatters: This shift is crucial for developers and businesses, as it lowers the barrier to entry and forces a reevaluation of AI pricing strategies across the industry.
